No interest. No compromise. No shame.
Just a fully endorsed, government backed alternative specifically designed to meet religious demands.

But don’t worry, they say it’s available to “everyone.”
That’s like saying a halal butcher serves vegetarians too.
This was designed by Islam, for Islam and everyone knows it.

⚠️ This is state-funded religious apartheid.

But when it’s Sharia? It’s “inclusive.”

No. It’s submission.

You can’t afford to heat your home.

Veterans are homeless. Pubs are shutting.
And the State is busy bending the knee to Sharia law in student loan offices.

They’re not asking for equality.

And they’re getting it funded by you and protected by cowards in suits too terrified to say what this really is:

THE CREATION OF A RELIGIOUS STATE WITHIN A SECULAR ONE.

Sharia finance today.
Sharia housing tomorrow.
Sharia courts? Already here.
Sharia Britain? Already building.

This isn’t about Muslims it’s about British sovereignty.

One country.

One system.
No special rules for anyone ever.

This is not negotiable.
Because if we tolerate this, we’ll soon be the foreigners in a land our ancestors died to defend.

We must tear this out at the root.
End the Sharia schemes.
End the religious carve outs.
End the cowardice.

This is our country.
And we will not fund its surrender.
